topic: Unknown-plant and out-of-scope-plant are DIFFERENT outcomes: one is 'no mapping configured', the other is 403
lesson: The plant-scope guard in MisSelectionService.run() combined two distinct cases into one 403: . A plant the mapping master does not cover yields canonicalPlant === undefined, which is NOT an authorization failure — it is precisely the UNRESOLVABLE outcome the story requires ('A selection with no mapping renders zeros + a no mapping configured notice, no crash' — spec acceptance criterion 3, and the resolved/unresolvable union task 3 consumes). Throwing 403 there breaks that criterion and hides the notice the UI must show. SPLIT the branches: canonicalPlant undefined -> return the explicit unresolvable outcome; canonicalPlant known but NOT in plantScope(user) -> throw the authorization error. Keep the authorization check strictly about scope, never about coverage.
